## Outboard

### THE DISC ORGANISER (for DISCIPLE and PLUS D USERS)

DIRECTORY ORGANISATION to show progs in any order you wish when you cat a disc! ALSO SECTOR CHECK & REPAIR; RECOVER ERASED PROGS; MULTIPLE Erase & Rename AND MUCH MORE! On tape for Auto-transfer to all Disc formats. ONLY £5 (inc. p&p in GB). Overseas add £1.50.

BETTERBYTES SOFTWARE, 10 SPITAL TERRACE, GOSFORTH, NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE. NE3 1UT.

---

### WANTED: Model Railway

Information/advice on using the Spectrum to control a MODEL RAILWAY. Contact: CHRIS CLAYTON, 21 RUDCHESTER CLOSE, CARLISLE, CA2 7XL (Carlisle 32150).

---

### ZX-COMAL

ZX-COMAL inclusive English manual. Structure your programs with PROC, LOOP, CASE, etc. Single key entry, 32K programmable RAM free. Normally only tape operations but info included with tips on how to use disc or microdrive. Only 135 dkr (about £12) including postage. Please use GIRO 8 56 41 91.

Address: Leif Mortensen, Bryggervangen 29, DK-7120 Vejle 0st, Denmark. DELIVERY: 14 DAYS.

---

### For Sale: R.D. Digital Tracer

One R.D. Digital Tracer for sale, £25.00 or nearest offer. — Alan Rutherford, 33 Montgomery Road, Cove, Farnborough, Hants, GU14 0AY.

---

### OPUS DISCOVERY CLUB

Write for details of their newsletter which is on disc and has software, info, tips, etc. to: 57 St.Saviours Road, WEST CROYDON, Surrey, CR0 2XE.

---

### OUTBOARD BB ADVERT

The Gnome At Home is a BB that has a SPECCY section called SPECTACULAR. You can ring it on (01)888-8894, it uses normal viewdata (like PRESTEL) s/w. The page for Speccys is \*spect.0# see you there! — Brian Gaff.

### Do You Understand OUTCLASS?

What is this machine code they're talking about anyway? What is memory management? What does PUSH HL mean? The author of OUTCLASS brings you the complete beginner's guide to Z80 assembly language. For just £3 you get the whole package from complete beginners upwards.

Send for a copy now to: Beginner's Course (OUTLET), Nick Lewis, 52 Kyle Crescent, Whitchurch, Cardiff, CF4 1SU. Don't wait! Send Now!
